V3-EXQ-999 (2026-09-03, ree-cloud-2, 43m52s) NON-CONTRIBUTORY -- first run ever to tag MECH-161 (claims.yaml evidence: []). The run aborted at its first seed on the P0 readiness precondition baseline_avoidance_discrimination_margin, measured -0.2608 against a +0.05 floor, and self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue. THE SELF-ROUTE'S CAUSAL STORY IS WRONG, and the correction is the finding. The precondition is labelled 'positive control that hazard-avoidance behaviour was trained at all', but the statistic (avoidant-action rate in the HIGH hazard bin minus the SAFE bin, where the 'avoidant action' is the geometric argmax of the away-from-nearest-hazard vector) cannot certify training, because the response is defined identically in both bins and therefore carries no signal/noise asymmetry. Measured directly against this driver's own readout replayed on the same env config and seeds: an ORACLE taking the correct avoidant action on EVERY step scores hit_rate = false_alarm_rate = 1.000 and sensitivity = +0.0000 on all three seeds, FAILING the +0.05 gate; the realizable oracle (avoidant action chosen at each E3 tick, P=10, held between) scores -0.0100 and also fails; and policy-free nulls with zero hazard knowledge score -0.126 (uniform-random), -0.130 (held P=5), -0.061 (held P=10) and -0.436 (held P=20), single-seed values spanning +0.109 to -0.583. The observed -0.2608 sits inside that null band.
